detail.longDescription:
If there's one thing I really wish for in terms of managing communities, it's one where even in the worst conditions of internet freedom, you can join and participate in a community who will welcome you.

This is what I want to do with Foxworks. I want to make a community that anyone can reach no matter their situation, and will welcome said user to the community with open arms. From what I have gathered, other communities exist which block Tor for their own comfort which honestly sucks for those who use it with good intentions, and I won't have that for my community. I also want people to be able to participate even if they do not want to make an account on a service they don't want to make an account on. As such, I'm willing to host my community on places that embrace Tor usage and I am also willing to host my community on services that do not require an account on said service to participate.

Of course, I do not want Foxworks to become a cesspit so I shamelessly stole the @the@starlightnet.work code of conduct and modified it for my own use case. I want to prioritise the safety of our community over the comfort of a select few so I would be happy to remove people who make others in the community feel unsafe. This is why I want to embrace anonymity in Foxworks so that people who are not safe to be themselves in their country can at least be safe in Foxworks behinds Tor, and anyone who tries to go against said safety would be punished.

I am aware this will be a lot worse to moderate given that technologies are often used by spammers to cause destruction for any reason, and I think that is a good thing. I believe that this will promote us to work on solutions to moderation in IRC, and therefore improve the IRC scene as a whole with better moderation tools. This will still mean issues will occur consistently but I believe we will be better off because of it, while being the most open software community.

If you are interested, check out #foxworks on irc.oftc.net and https://sr.ht/~amadaluzia/foxworks for more information. I would be interested in bringing on a diverse community and moderation team so that issues can be represented fairly.

#foss #opensource #software #noai #programming
